g_p24: Everyone looked up at Siegfried as he got ready to swing the energy at Fafnir, who was already charging up a breath of destruction at him.
g_p25:
"Prepare yourself!

The Evil Dragon shall fall, and the world will reach its sunset.

I will bring you down ―Balmung!"
g_p26: Siegfried unleashed his Noble Phantasm against Fafnir as it let out a loud, devastating roar as he was enveloped by the powerful energy of Balmung, completely destroying him as his roars disappeared.
h_p1: Dark Jeanne muttered, staring at the massive light where she saw Fafnir just seconds ago…defeated by humans? By humans!? She gave a wet cough.
h_jeannealter2: Jeanne Alter : HOW!? HOW DID HUMANS GET THIS FAR!?
h_p2: Because of that earlier attack from both her counterpart and the bug, she was greatly injured to the point where she was struggling to even stand up yet somehow managed through sheer willpower alone. But her body still felt greatly after that exposure to that dark power she just used.
h_sora1b: Sora told her, huffing slightly as his clothes and Keyblade had returned to normal.
h_p3: Dark Jeanne tried to take a step forward but then fell on her knees. Her body had reached its limits and she could feel her Spirit Origins had been damaged to the point that she would end up fading away into nothingness.
h_jeannealter4: Jeanne Alter : No! I…I can still keep going! As long as you’re still around, I’ll never be nothing more than a shadow!
h_sora3: Sora : You are more than just a shadow.
h_p5: Dark Jeanne looked at him in confusion.
h_sora4: Sora : Even though you aren’t Jeanne’s darkness, even though you’re just a copy of her, it shouldn’t have to change anything.
h_sora5: Sora : Because at the end of the day, you are real. You’re still Jeanne d’Arc despite all this. And that means that you have every right to be your own person just like everybody else and not be a shadow of someone else.
h_p6: Dark Jeanne stared at him with her mouth open in disbelief at his words and the gentle smile he sent her way. Her other self…nodded her head at her and shared the same smile as well, as though to tell her that she too felt the same way he did and that she too wanted her to be her own person.
h_p7: Wha...just what the hell were these two saying? Is this supposed to be some kind of sick twisted joke or something!? It just doesn’t make any damn sense! Were these two really stupid or something?
h_p8: Damn it, these two are giving her a headache!
h_p9: Before she could say something to them, more than likely an insult, she felt a tingle hit her head.
h_jeannealter5: Jeanne Alter : Gilles…? Fine. Just…just get me out of here.
h_jeannealter5b: The moment she said that, she vanished into thin air.
h_sora6b: Sora exclaimed, looking around for her.
h_jeanne2b: Jeanne said, turning to stare at the castle with Sora doing the same thing.
h_jeanne3: Jeanne : He must’ve called her back to the castle.
h_jeanne3b: Sora glared at the castle for a couple of seconds as he nodded at her words. He turned away from it to look at the Saint.
h_sora7: Sora : Come on! Let’s go meet up with Ritsuka and the others!
h_p10: Jeanne turned and nodded her head at him as the two ran off to where they saw Siegfried use his Noble Phantasm on Fafnir. It didn’t take them very long as they saw everyone gathered together around Ritsuka, who was sitting on the ground drinking some Elixir.
h_p11: Hearing Sora’s yell made everyone turn to them as they saw the two running up to them. Marie immediately ran up to them and quickly gave a hug to Jeanne first and then Sora.
h_marie1b: The queen said happily as she released Sora from her hug.
h_mash1: Mash : Thank goodness you’re both okay.
h_mash1b: Mash said with much relief in her voice.
h_sora9: Sora : Same with all of you.
h_sora9b: Sora smiled at her but then turned to Ritsuka with a worried look.
h_ritsuka1b: Ritsuka reassured him with Sora nodding at him but still looking worried.
h_sora12: Sora : That big blue fire that destroyed Fafnir.
h_siegfried1: Siegfried : It was Balmung, my Noble Phantasm.
h_siegfried2: Siegfried : Fujimaru used a Command Spell to help increase my power. Thanks to the fact he keeps doing crazy things, alongside the enhancement charms you gave him, his body’s getting used to it. So Dr. Romani explained.
h_romani1: Romani : [Yup. That was a little too close, if you ask me. There was a chance his magic circuits might burn out, but thankfully it didn’t happen.]
h_p12: Sora looked amazed by that and his smile suddenly got bigger.
h_sora13: Sora : That’s awesome, Ritsuka! That means you’re a Dragon Slayer now!
h_p13: Ritsuka laughed sheepishly at that, scratching the back of his head.
h_ritsuka2: Ritsuka : It was thanks to everyone here that we managed to beat him. I’m really glad that we’re all together again.
h_archer1: Archer : So what happened with Dark Jeanne?
h_jeanne4: Jeanne : Gilles called her back to the castle.
h_jeanne5: Jeanne : Though…it won’t be long until she disappears.
h_artoria1: Artoria : So then all that’s left is Caster.
h_cu1: Cú : Alright, so what’s the plan?
h_cu1b: Cú asked, motioning his head towards the rampaging wyverns that were fighting against the soldiers on the battlefield.
h_cu2: Cú : We got rid of the Evil Dragon, but with no leader to guide them, those dragons are out of control now.
h_siegfried3: Siegfried : Some of us are going to stay and help take care of them.
h_siegfried3b: Siegfried said, lifting his sword up.
h_siegfried4: Siegfried : I shall stay behind him.
h_georgios1: Georgios : I will stay as well.
h_georgios2: Georgios : There’s a good chance the Heartless will pop out during the battle and I’m afraid they might be too much for them. So I will offer my aid, however I can.
h_marie2b: Marie placed a hand on her chest and looked determined.
h_marie3: Marie Antoinette : As a Queen, I shall do my best to protect my citizens.
h_amadeus1: Amadeus : And I can’t leave my Queen by her lonesome.
h_amadeus1b: Amadeus scratched his cheek with a finger.
h_amadeus2: Amadeus : Especially after the tearful goodbye she gave to Chevalier after their fight.
h_marie4: Marie Antoinette : Amadeus! Don’t tell them!
h_marie4b: Marie cried out as she tried to hit him on his chest as he tried to block them. She was truly saddened that she had to part ways with her knight despite them on opposing sides. She still remembered the tears Chevalier shed as she was disappearing asking for her forgiveness. With tearful hug, she forgave her dear knight.
h_p14: Ritsuka nodded at them, before turning to his own Servants.
h_ritsuka3: Ritsuka : Emiya, Cú, you both stay here and help them out. Like Georgios said, the Heartless will probably pop out so they’re gonna need an extra hand.
h_archer2b: Emiya said, Cú nodding in agreement.
h_mash2: Mash : So that means the rest of us are going to the castle?
h_sora14b: Sora said, helping Ritsuka stand up, who nodded in appreciation for the action.
h_ritsuka4: Ritsuka : Then let’s not keep Gilles waiting.
i_p1: Dark Jeanne felt terribly tired. She tried to keep her eyes open, but couldn't manage it. She couldn't even stand anymore. After Gilles had called her back to the castle, he had carried her to her throne and set her down as gently as he could. And yet… she couldn't get what that insect had told her out of her head.
i_darkjeanne1: Jeanne Alter : Gilles… Tell me… I'm real, aren't I?
i_gilles1: Caster Gilles : Yes, Jeanne. You are real.
i_gilles1_note: He answered softly, stroking her hair.
i_gilles2: Caster Gilles : Please, rest. You must be exhausted.
i_darkjeanne2: Jeanne Alter : …Yeah. I am. I'm just… I'm done with all of this.
i_darkjeanne2_note: Dark Jeanne said, closing her eyes.
i_p2: So… this is how it ends for her, huh? Dying like this, without even getting the chance to destroy France for… No. No. That's wrong. Like that insect said—and she hates to admit it—they never did anything to her.
i_p3: The real Jeanne d'Arc carried no darkness within her, even after being murdered in cold blood. She still loved France, because she kept wonderful, happy memories with her family and friends. Whereas her… she had none of that. She was nothing but a replica full of hatred.
i_p4: It's funny. Death didn't even scare her. In fact, she felt nothing about her situation. Just acceptance. Good riddance for a fake like her. And yet… she still wondered… what happens to a fake like her? Where does she go? Would she simply fade away, just like that?
i_p5: Bah. Whatever. It's not like it mattered anyway.
i_sora1_note: Dark Jeanne struggled to open her eyes and looked up. She saw that insect and his friends running into the throne room. He and his double had that sad, sickening look, as if they didn't want her to leave. She turned her head toward Gilles, who didn't even bother paying attention to their arrival and simply kept stroking her head.
i_gilles3: Caster Gilles : Don't worry, Jeanne. Let me handle this. I'll take care of everything.
i_p6: She looked at him, then slowly turned her eyes toward Sora and Jeanne. There was no more hatred left in her gaze, especially not toward Sora, whom she stared at a little longer than the others. Without even realizing it, she gave them a small smile… a sincere, apologetic smile that surprised them all, then she closed her eyes… and vanished.
i_p7: In doing so, she left behind the Holy Grail, resting on her throne.
i_romani1: Romani : [Looks like we were right all along. Dark Jeanne was the Holy Grail the whole time.]
i_gilles4: Caster Gilles : Yes. It truly is sad, isn't it?
i_gilles4_note: Gilles answered, picking up the Holy Grail and staring at it.
i_gilles5: Caster Gilles : My Saint…I can't believe this whole time she was exposed to the truth of her origins.
i_p8: He then turned to look at everyone.
i_gilles6: Caster Gilles : I must say, it's a pleasure to meet you all. Especially you, the false Jeanne I met somewhere else.
i_p9: Artoria glared at him angrily as she remembered his actions from the mentioned place. The innocent children he and his former Master kidnapped and murdered before transforming into a hideous monstrosity that took the combined efforts of the other Servants and Masters to beat.
i_gilles7: Caster Gilles : And it's been a while hasn't it, Jeanne d'Arc?
i_gilles7_note: Gilles asked, turning to her with a soft look on his face.
i_jeanne1_note: Jeanne said softly, staring at his current form with sadness in her eyes. He had truly fallen after her demise.
i_jeanne2: Jeanne : Tell me, how were you able to be summoned in this era?
i_gilles8: Caster Gilles : I was summoned by the Grail through my connection with the me of this era.
i_gilles8_note: Gilles answered with his smile turning into a smirk.
i_gilles9: Caster Gilles : So of course, that also means that I was the first Servant to find the Grail and use its power to destroy France!
i_sora3: Sora : So you created Dark Jeanne just so you can use her as a tool of destruction for what France did to Jeanne!
i_gilles10: Caster Gilles : Foolish boy. I never saw her as a tool.
i_gilles10_note: Gilles said, looking genuinely angry at the accusation.
i_gilles11: Caster Gilles : My only wish was for Jeanne's revival. That was all I ever wanted of the Grail. A wish from the bottom of my heart.
i_gilles11_note: His face warped into one of anger.
i_gilles12: Caster Gilles : But my wish was unfulfilled!
i_gilles13: Caster Gilles : But I only wished for you and you alone! That was the one thing that omnipotent wishing device can't do! So instead I created a new you! The Saint I believed in! The Saint I longed for! I created her! Jeanne d'Arc - The Dragon Witch! The Grail itself!
i_jeanne4: Jeanne : At first, she had no idea of her origins until at the very end of her lifespan. Gilles, even if you could revive me, I would never be your Dragon Witch.
i_jeanne5: Jeanne : It's true that I was betrayed, it's true that I was mocked. My life ended as a tragic tale. But I could never hate my homeland. This is where you and the others live, where I have so many precious memories of before I joined the war.
i_gilles14_note: Gilles' face returned to a more serene expression as he smiled at her.
i_gilles15: Caster Gilles : Your words are always too kind. However, Jeanne…
i_gilles15_note: The serene expression disappeared and was more blank.
i_gilles16: Caster Gilles : Your kindness has made you forget one thing. Even if you never hated this country…
i_gilles16_note: His eyes went wide and veins along his neck bulged as his face contorted with rage.
i_gilles17: Caster Gilles : I HATED THIS COUNTRY! I swore I would destroy it for this betrayal of you!
i_p10: Jeanne's eyes widened as she heard this, looking at her childhood friend with sadness. Everyone around all tensed while Sora's hair shadowed his eyes.
i_gilles18: Caster Gilles : You will forgive them I'm sure. But I never will! Not God! Not the King! Not the nation!
i_gilles18_note: Gilles continued on with his ranting rage.
i_gilles19: Caster Gilles : I will destroy them! I will kill them! That is the wish I made-!
i_p11: Gilles' cried out in pain as he was struck in the chest by a thrown object, which knocked him back and made him crash on the throne. Everyone was shocked by the action as they looked at the object that was thrown and saw it was Kingdom Key, which vanished and reappeared in Sora's hand. He didn't say anything as he took several steps forward until he was in front of Jeanne.
i_sora4: Sora : What's wrong with you? Are you that selfishly blind or just ignorant?
i_p12: Gilles, who placed his hand on his chest after being struck, looked at Sora to listen to what he had to say.
i_sora5: Sora : I know the pain of what it's like to lose your friends. It's unbearable. I can also understand your anger and hatred for this country after they killed Jeanne. I know because I felt the same way when I learned about Jeanne and Marie's history.
i_sora5_note: Sora told him, getting everyone's undivided attention as he said those words.
i_sora6: Sora : But there's a difference between me and you. I don't hate the country, I hate the people, the ones who killed them after all the good they tried to do for them. If there's anything that you should hate, it's them!
i_jeanne6_note: Jeanne was about to stop him but a hand on her shoulder stopped her. Glancing back, she saw her Master shaking his head at her to tell her not interfere.
i_sora7: Sora : You say you want to destroy all of France and its people for their betrayal of Jeanne, but what about those who cared about her?
i_sora7_note: Sora asked rhetorically, though with an added tone of anger in it.
i_sora8: Sora : Were you so upset about Jeanne's death that you didn't even think about how it also affected them?
i_p13: His voice was getting louder as he started to show his anger at Gilles for what he said to Jeanne. Everyone else was also surprised to hear Sora's sudden increase in volume as he spoke.
i_sora9: Sora : Her hometown, her friends, her family!
i_sora9_note: Sora yelled at Gilles, who was looking at him in surprise.
i_sora10: Sora : Are you going to tell me that they betrayed her too? When they had no idea what was going on with her until it was too late?
i_p14: Gilles gave no reply, though his eyes did widen just as Sora continued showing Gilles and everyone his righteous anger at Gilles' selfishness.
i_sora11: Sora : Did you even bother to check up on them!? To comfort them, to cry with them, to share the happy memories you all had with Jeanne?! No, you didn't! You didn't do any of those things! You fell into darkness, practiced Black Magecraft and as a result you committed so many horrible things just so you could prove a point! Do you really think Jeanne would want you to do something like that after she died!?
i_p15: He still couldn't get over what he learned from Jeanne about Gilles' history, a loyal French soldier who fell into ruin after Jeanne's death. He lost sight of God and devoted himself to Black Magecraft out of his despair. His hands became stained with blood. He kidnapped young boys from his territory, raped and then murdered them.
i_p16: Sora was completely horrified and sickened greatly once he found out that he's been doing this action alongside many others for 8 years after Jeanne's death. But it wasn't until in 1440, was Gilles executed. However, the people back then, they didn't do it as justice or for the children he raped and murdered. No, they killed him just for his fortune and his land. They say they killed him for the children, but it was an excuse to satisfy their own sick greed.
i_p17: It just made Sora even more hateful and angry at the people of this era. Did they really not care for the children that Gilles killed in cold blood? Of course not. Because according to Jeanne, the people of that era were split into two groups; Nobles and Commoners. Those children that Gilles killed were all commoners.
i_p18: Because the nobles of the era disregarded the human rights of commoners, they felt the populations of their territories were no more than disposable livestock. They equated their slaughter to no more than animal abuse and would not have even dealt with Gilles had his land holdings not been so large and him being wasteful of his fortune.
i_p19: Otherwise, they wouldn't have waited 8 whole years just to finally execute him. But those nobles, they didn't do it for justice or their faith, it was just so they take his fortunes for themselves. It was really disgusting to learn how the people of this era acted out and the kind of system they lived in during that time.
i_p20: It was hard to believe that this version of Gilles became a Heroic Spirit. He could see the Knight Gilles being one, but this one, not so much.
i_sora12_note: Sora called out his name, his voice echoing out in the room.
i_sora13: Sora : We're not going to let you destroy Jeanne's home! The home she fought to protect, the home where she has precious memories of everyone in it, including you!
i_sora13_note: He looked at Gilles and showed him the angry but very determined expression he wore.
i_sora14: Sora : We will stop you and end this fight once and for all!
i_p21: The Chaldea group all stared at Sora with awestruck looks on their faces though Ritsuka had a knowing smile on his face as he agreed with what Sora said. He never felt emotions as strong as Gilles, so he won't pretend that he knows how he feels. But he doesn't think Gilles is wrong. It's natural that he would hate this world after it took his precious friend away from him.
i_p22: But what he did after...the terrible things he's done? It was absolutely sick and disgusting! Even he can admit that Gilles went too far in his hatred for France. Just like right now. And that's why they're going to stop him!
i_p23: Jeanne's face turned red slightly with her eyes also glistening. She looked ready to cry right about now but after closing her eyes for a couple of seconds, she opened them back up and nodded to herself, her face and eyes reflecting the same determination as the Keyblade Master.
i_p24: Gilles meanwhile just stared at Sora with widened eyes, his words all but ringing inside his head. Jeanne's family…that's right. He never once thought about them after Jeanne's death. They all just slipped his mind after he fell into despair with Jeanne's death. All he cared about was Jeanne. His world, his motivation, all revolved around her because she was living proof of his salvation and God's existence. His precious Saint.
i_p25: But now this boy…who wields…the key…
i_gilles20: Caster Gilles : ...I see. It was you.
i_gilles20_note: Gilles said as he stood up, his eyes staring at the Keyblade before looking directly at Sora.
i_gilles21: Caster Gilles : You were the one who broke my Dragon Witch. The one who took her away from me.
i_gilles21_note: His face soon turned into a hateful scowl.
i_p26: Sora remained silent, not even flinching away at how messed up Gilles' face looked right now with the scowl on his face. He was even stomping his foot on the ground angrily.
i_gilles23_note: Gilles continued to yell as the Holy Grail entered his body, granting him near-infinite power. He took out his book, which looked to be made of actual human flesh, and opened it up.
i_gilles24: Caster Gilles : YOU WILL PAY FOR TAKING MY DRAGON WITCH AWAY!
i_gilles24_note: He continued yelling with a voice warped by madness.
i_gilles25: Caster Gilles : I WILL MAKE SURE YOU WILL DIE A GRUESOME PAINFUL DEATH, BOY! YOU AND EVERYONE ELSE!
i_p27: Darkness had appeared all around Gilles, which made a strong gust of wind to try and blow them back, yet they remained strong and firm in the face of it. The Servants quickly summoned their weapons as well.
i_gilles26: Caster Gilles : EVEN IF I HAVE TO USE THIS NEW DARK POWER, MY WISH FOR FRANCE'S DESTRUCTION WILL BE REALIZED! DON'T STAND IN MY WAY, JEANNE D'ARC!
i_p28: The darkness that appeared around Gilles soon covered his whole entire body in a massive orb that started to hover up in the air.
i_romani2: Romani : [Everyone! Stay away from him! The readings we're picking up from him are all messed up! They're not making any sense!]
i_romani2_note: Dr. Roman said in alarm and a slightly scared tone.
i_ritsuka1: Ritsuka : Everyone! Take cover behind Mash!
i_ritsuka1_note: Ritsuka ordered. Everyone did as ordered with Mash holding her shield up, though Sora had to grab the frozen Jeanne's hand and get her to join them.
i_p29: The dark energy soon erupted off of his body, blasting upwards, through the ceiling of the room, breaking through the stone and wood that made up the castle roof and leaving the debris to scatter everywhere inside and out.
i_p30: They couldn't see how far the energy went from where they were, but it was safe to assume that it reached far up into the sky. The dark energy soon dispersed to reveal a new kind of creature that made Sora narrow his eyes up at it while everyone else was shocked and mildly disgusted at it.
i_p31: It was a grotesque monster that looked like it was created in a laboratory from a mixture of different demons. Its lower body was a mass of darkened flesh that was mixed together with some parts of it even pulsing with various tentacles moving around. It has a dark purple octopus head complete with bulging glowing yellow fish-like eyes and razor sharp shark-like teeth with 'hair' in a style similar to Gilles.
i_p32: The creature also had claws, one big and one smaller, but there were crevices on them, like cracks in the earth itself, which glowed a sinister eerie purple. The creature also had two large tentacles on its back.
i_elizabeth1_note: Elizabeth screamed out loud, ducking behind the shield.
i_kiyohime1: Kiyohime : EW! EW! EW! EW! DISGUSTING!
i_kiyohime1_note: Kiyohime also screamed as she joined her.
i_romani3: Romani : [It can't be! We're picking up readings of the Grail from that thing but it's like something is corrupting it! W-What the hell is that thing!?]
i_sora15_note: Sora answered, coming out from behind the shield, taking note of the Heartless Emblem on the torso.
i_mash1_note: Mash asked in shock, looking up at the abomination before she too noticed the emblem. This thing was the darkness that took shape inside of Gilles' heart?
i_p33: Ritsuka recoils in horror and repulsion by what he's looking at. So this is what Gilles' Heartless looked like? It looked like a demon!
i_artoria1: Artoria : The strong anger and hatred he holds for France.
i_artoria1_note: Artoria said, staring wide eyed at the creature.
i_artoria2: Artoria : It allowed him to transform into a Heartless.
i_romani5: Romani : [I…I can't believe it! A Servant can actually turn into a Heartless!? Something like is possible!?]
i_jeanne7_note: Jeanne said, staring at her friend with a guilty look on her face. This situation reminded her about what Sora told them the story about the Pride Lands. Just like what happened to Scar, Gilles had transformed himself into a Heartless because of the darkness inside him.
i_sora17_note: Sora told her, getting her attention.
i_sora18: Sora : It's not your fault that he became this way. Everything that's happened to him, everything he did, were all done by his choices. So there's nothing for you to feel guilty about.
i_sora18_note: He turned to look at her with a smile.
i_p34: Jeanne stared at Sora for a couple of seconds before she smiled softly at him and nodded her head. He was right. There's nothing for her to feel guilty about. Gilles made his choice and he will forever have to live with the consequences of his actions. Looking back at his Heartless, she slammed her flagpole down and released her banner.
i_jeanne8: Jeanne : In the name of Ruler, Jeanne d'Arc, I hand down the sentence to that monster! Everyone, I request your assistance! Please, lend me your strength!
i_jeanne8_note: Everyone acknowledged Jeanne’s wish as they all nodded their heads at her with smiles or smirks on their faces.
i_sora20: Sora : Did you even have to ask?
i_sora20_note: Sora asked, making her smile in appreciation at him.
i_jeanne9_note: Jeanne thanked them as they then turned to Gilles and got into stances.
i_jeanne10: Jeanne : Evil Marshal, Gilles de Rais! Prepare yourself!
i_p35: Gilles' Heartless, the Demon Bluebeard, roars at the group as it launches its tentacles at them. Sora, Jeanne and Artoria all cut the tentacles off with Elizabeth charging ahead to try and stab at it, only for one of the large tentacles to slap her away. The other large tentacle made its way to Fujimaru as though it tried to stab him, but Mash had her shield up and knocked it away. Kiyohime followed it up by swiping her fan and launched a wave of fire at it, burning it greatly as the flames danced on its disgusting skin.
i_p36: Demon Bluebeard cries out in pain from that before pointing it's larger claw out at and fires a steam of dark purple gas at the group, getting them to move out of the way, not even bothering to figure out what it was nor what it would do to them the moment it touched them.
i_p37: Artoria yells as she charges ahead and starts to strike the appendage off, only for the tentacles of its lower body to move and block it, getting her to cut them instead. She grit her teeth at this but then her eyes widened when she saw it was about to sweep its big claw at her, getting her to try and block and was launched into a wall.
i_p38: Sora, Mash and Jeanne charged in at the same time. Sora fired a Fire spell at its face, getting it to screech and cover its face with its small claw. Mash jumps up and spins around while holding her shield out. She gave a yell as her shield landed a hit across its head, knocking it to the side and throwing its large claw up in the exposed air. Jeanne gave her own yell as she and Elizabeth both slashed the large appendage off, getting it to fall on the floor.
i_p39: The gargantuan Heartless let out a roar of pain with a mix of anger. Surprisingly, in its rage it summoned dark portals and out came multiple small creatures, which were masses of tentacles with circular mouth-like openings marked with shark teeth-like blades.
i_artoria3: Artoria : Tch! Even as Heartless, he can still summon those demons?
i_artoria3_note: Artoria asked as she cut one that tried to jump and it disappeared.
i_elizabeth2: Elizabeth : Oh come on! Just how gross can this thing get!?
i_elizabeth2_note: Elizabeth asked, looking down at the small creatures with disgust.
i_kiyohime2_note: Kiyohime told her, annoyed by her attitude but at the same also felt disgusted by them and was already setting them on fire.
i_mash2_note: Mash immediately came to Ritsuka and knocked away several monsters that were closing in on him.
i_p40: Demon Bluebeard roars again and charges at Sora and Jeanne while swinging its small claw. The two of them blocked it, giving Artoria the chance to come and attack it. First, she thrust her sword at it and then followed it up with several heavy attacks that pushed it back.
i_artoria4_note: She released the wind in her sword and shot out a violent gale that blew Demon Bluebeard all back until it destroyed a portion of the wall.
i_p41: The Heartless let out a loud screech with wind lashing around it. The large claw that was cut off had been re-growned and it was now glaring at them.
i_p42: Demon Bluebeard used its tentacles as a makeshift helicopter and charged at them. Everyone got out of its way as it landed before it charged at them again. It swung its claws around while it emitted dark energy. The group avoided it once again only to be caught off guard when they were all captured by the tentacles it had summoned and they all struggled to get out.
i_elizabeth3: Elizabeth : EW! It's so slimy! Let me go, you ugly freak of nature!
i_elizabeth3_note: Elizabeth demanded, before letting out out a Sonic Screech that made Demon Bluebeard counter it with it's own screech that shook the room.

k_p14: Director Olga Marie Animusphere has returned.

k_p19: Olga blinked at everyone. It took her a few seconds to realize where she was at. She looked at her hands and touched her face, even going so far as to pull her cheeks. Once she realized she wasn't dreaming, tears fell from her eyes and she broke down crying in front of everyone.
k_p21: Somewhere else, the heart of the Dragon Witch wandered aimlessly. She had no idea where she was at or why she was even still…existing. Without the Grail to tether her to the world, she should be gone. But…here she is, still conscious but barely keeping it together as is.
k_p22: What the hell was going on? No, how can something like her still…exist.
k_p23: That's right! Gilles! She was created by Gilles' wish for revenge against France. Without the Grail, her existence was weak but it still exists nonetheless. Which means she has to find some way to be something again!
k_p25: That's it! Jeanne d'Arc! She's the key! Even though she denied her being every aspect of her, she still acknowledged her existence along with that key wielding punk. All she has to do is to figure a way to get her to acknowledge the darkness that she kept hidden from her so that she can be some element of her.
k_p26: But that will be tricky. Like she just said, Jeanne d'Arc denied any such aspects she has within her. So if she doesn't have any flaws that would result in her existing, then that means she has to make that flaw happen.
k_p27: Hehehehe…this is going to be so good! She can't wait to see the looks on that goodie-two shoes Saint and little bug's face when they see her again!
k_p28: Those fools better watch out. Because the Dragon Witch is coming back!
k_p32: Now when the hell where they going to summon her counterpart!?
